The Cardinal, led by sixth year head coach [[Johnny Dawkins]], played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] and were members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. The team finished with an overall of record 23–13 and were 10–8 in conference play Stanford lost in the semifinals of the [[2014 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2013–14 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] 84–59 {{cite news|url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/ucla/la-sp-ucla-stanford-pac-12-20140315-story.html|title=UCLA rolls Stanford, 84-59, to get to
